title: JSX must return one root element

slides.say: Rule one of JSX: a component returns one single root element.
This returns two tags side by side, a heading and a list. That is an error.

slides.text: JSX becomes JavaScript objects. A function cannot return two objects without wrapping them.
slides.say: Why? JSX is turned into plain JavaScript objects. You cannot return two objects from a function without wrapping them.

slides.text: Wrap in a <div>, or in a Fragment <> </>.
slides.say: So wrap them in one parent, like a div. Or use the empty tags, called a Fragment, which leave no trace in the HTML.
